arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse
fmt = '''
letters: {:w}
non-letters: {:W}
whitespace: \"{ :s}\"
non-whitespace: \t{:S}\n
digits: {:d}
non-digits: {:D}
'''
data = '''
letters: abcdef_GHIJLK
non-letters: !@#%\$ *^%
whitespace: \"   \\t\\n\"
non-whitespace: \tabc\n
digits: 0xabcdef
non-digits: abcdef
'''
p = parse.Parser(fmt)
print('Expression:', repr(p._expression))
try:
    r = p.parse(data)
    print('Result:', r)
except Exception as e:
    import traceback
    traceback.print_exc()
" 2>&1 | tail -20
